body:
Portal login/home pages now use IDUNA's real cream/gold ceremony aesthetic (Cormorant Garamond + Spectral, matching IDUNA/index.html and IDUNA/styles.css) instead of an invented dark-tech placeholder, with real Prompt-o-verse gallery art (fenrir-robot, fox-robot) served as static files under /portal/images/. Added /portal/logout. Designed via /design canvas 'notebook-portal' first, then ported into the live Go templates. go build/go test clean. Commit 8489324.

⚓ ☃
title: Restyled notebook portal to the real IDUNA style guide + Prompt-o-verse art
